critical_code_review_comments: BookingForm.jsx handleBook (lines 90-108) correctly ALWAYS opens WhatsApp regardless of postLead() success — verified by 404 simulation. This is the correct fix for the reported prod 404 issue (Vercel routing).

tracking.js generateLeadFired module-level guard correctly fires GA4 generate_lead exactly once per session even across multiple submits. form_submit correctly fires each time. GA4 config G-BBKY82CFQG loads at page init.

API base logic (BookingForm.jsx line 19-20) branches on full-URL vs relative-path fallback ('/api'). In preview the absolute-URL branch is used; the relative-path branch would activate on Vercel where vercel.json rewrites /api/* to the backend. Cannot be validated live from the preview.

server.py CORS: allow_credentials=True with wildcard '*' via CORS_ORIGINS default is technically invalid per CORS spec, but currently benign because allow_origin_regex covers *.discoverdazeholidays.com. Recommend setting CORS_ORIGINS explicitly to comma-separated origins in prod .env (unchanged from iteration_6 note).

rca_of_the_issue: The reported production 404 on the lead form is a Vercel routing/env misconfiguration (not backend, which returns 200). The current fix in BookingForm.jsx (handleBook ALWAYS opens WhatsApp with the prefilled message regardless of postLead() success + surfaces the real error via toast.error) is verified correct — under a simulated 404 the enquiry still reaches the merchant via WhatsApp and the GA4 conversion is (correctly) suppressed. vercel.json rewrite /api/* -> backend + the same-origin '/api' fallback in the API base is the correct additional mitigation. No regressions in preview.
